title: Defending your project
objective: Défendre une proposition, comparer deux solutions et répondre avec courtoisie à une objection.
model_text: Our school should start a reading club. It could help students discover new books. Some people might say that students are too busy. However, we could meet only once a month. This solution is practical because it does not take much time. What do you think?

steps.title: Diagnostic rapide
steps.student_instruction: Explain your project in two sentences to a partner.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Réactiver la séance 3E-01 sans noter systématiquement.

steps.title: Lire et comprendre un argument
steps.student_instruction: Read the model. Highlight the claim, objection, response and reason.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Lire le modèle et demander des preuves textuelles.

steps.title: Boîte à outils argumentative
steps.student_instruction: Match each connector to its purpose and correct two short sentences.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Revoir should/could + base verbale, because, however.

steps.title: Préparer sa défense A/B/C
steps.student_instruction: Complete the planning sheet for your track.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Étayer A; demander un exemple concret à B et C.

steps.title: Questions croisées en binômes
steps.student_instruction: Ask one challenging but respectful question and improve your answer.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Distribuer les rôles et rappeler les règles de discussion.

steps.title: Mini-débats en groupes
steps.student_instruction: Defend your project and respond to at least one objection.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Groupes simultanés; observation ciblée et traces entre pairs.

steps.title: Exit ticket
steps.student_instruction: Write your best argument and one improvement.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Conserver un objectif pour la suite.

sheets.student_content: Complete: We should ___. It could help because ___. Some people say ___. However, we could ___. Read your argument aloud.
sheets.facilitator_correction: Réponse ouverte; vérifier un projet, une raison et une réponse à l'objection.

sheets.student_content: Write a short defence of your project: one claim, two reasons, one possible objection and a response. Prepare one question for another group.
sheets.facilitator_correction: Réponse ouverte; vérifier claim, arguments, objection, réponse et question.

sheets.student_content: Compare two ways to achieve the same project goal. Defend the more realistic option with two reasons, anticipate an objection and answer a follow-up question.
sheets.facilitator_correction: Réponse ouverte; vérifier comparaison, justification, prise en compte d'une objection et interaction.

common_errors.remediation: Après should, base verbale sans to.
